entities.name: Karel Škréta
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Karel Škréta Šotnovský of Závořice was a Czech painter who worked in the Baroque style. He was mostly a portrait painter and painter of altarpieces. He lived through the Thirty Years' War which caused him some hardships as a Protestant which led him to leave Prague for Saxony and then Italy.

entities.summary: Karel Škréta Šotnovský of Závořice was a Czech painter who worked in the Baroque style. He was mostly a portrait painter and painter of altarpieces. He lived through the Thirty Years' War which caused him some hardships as a Protestant which led him to leave Prague for Saxony and then Italy.
